The '''Techno Union Research and Development Wing''' was a section of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]

==History==
This wing of the union was concerned with researching and developing new technologies during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the organization sent a representative, [[Bunt Dantor]], to attend a panel debate on the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] show ''[[A Galaxy Divided]]'', where he discussed the possible nature and technologies behind the [[Malevolence/Legends|mysterious new CIS weapon]].
